en: Multi‑view color postcard with a dark red border showing a formal baroque park and palace. The upper images depict wide lawns with flowerbeds, stone balustrades and statues, including a large ornamental vase with sculpted figures on a pedestal. The lower left view shows a dynamic baroque sculpture group of two figures on a high base amid gardens. The lower right image shows a grand baroque palace with ornate façade and central pediment, fronted by a large pond or lake with many swans and a low, terraced shoreline.
